sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.logOpen: A brown wall walks in off the flats. Without a shelter you take it on the skin: grit in the eyes, water you did not agree to spend.
sandstorm.logShelter: The sandstorm rakes the fuselage. In the shelter you listen to it and lose only a little of the day.
sandstorm.journal: Sandstorms pin you to camp. A dug shelter turns them into noise. Caught in the open, they strip water and hours. Do not travel while the air is brown.

nightVisitor.log: Something was in the blankets. You find the scorpion by the way your hand lights up.
nightVisitor.shelterLog: Even in the shelter, without a fire, a scorpion tries the dark. It finds you.
